mapper.select: SELECT CALNG_DT AS CALLED_AT, RSPNS_STTUS_CD AS STATUS_CODE, INTE_MS AS ELAPSED_MS FROM DXAPI_CALL_HIST_L WHERE CALNG_DT >= #{since}

SELECT HIST_SEQ AS SEQ, CALNG_DT AS CALLED_AT, CONTCT_SYST_ID AS EXT_SYS_ID, API_NO AS API_NO, REQ_PATH AS REQ_PATH, HTTP_MTHD_DVCD AS METHOD, CLIENT_IP_ADDR AS CLIENT_IP, TRC_ID AS TRACE_ID, PARAM_JSON_TEXT AS PARAM_JSON, RSPNS_STTUS_CD AS STATUS_CODE, ERR_CD AS ERROR_CODE, INTE_MS AS ELAPSED_MS FROM DXAPI_CALL_HIST_L
AND RSPNS_STTUS_CD = #{statusCode} AND API_NO = #{apiNo} AND CONTCT_SYST_ID = #{extSysId} AND CALNG_DT >= #{from} AND CALNG_DT <= #{to}
AND ( REQ_PATH LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR TRC_ID LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR CLIENT_IP_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR ERR_CD LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' )
ORDER BY CALNG_DT DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
